name: Your pantry bolognese
description: Rich tomato, savory mince, and a generous twirl of spaghetti. Comfort, made simple.
steps: Get the pasta going
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add salt and spaghetti. Cook following the packet timing, then reserve a mug of pasta water before draining.
Build a rich sauce

Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the ground meat and break it apart. Cook thoroughly; ground beef or pork should reach 71°C, and ground poultry 74°C. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Bring it together
Add a splash of reserved pasta water and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring until saucy. Toss in the drained spaghetti. Add more pasta water as needed and season with pepper.

name: Simply tomato spaghetti
description: A silky tomato sauce from a humble spoonful of paste. Your new cupboard classic.
steps: Boil and save a little
Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water according to the packet. Save a mug of the starchy cooking water before draining.
Wake up the tomato
Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the tomato paste and stir for 2 minutes until it darkens slightly. Stir in enough pasta water to make a smooth sauce.
Twirl and serve
Add the spaghetti and toss over gentle heat for a minute. Loosen with more pasta water if needed. Season with pepper and serve warm.

name: Garlicky garden pasta
description: Tender greens and golden garlic. A fresh twist on the easiest dinner in the book.
steps: Cook the spaghetti
Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water according to the packet. Reserve a mug of pasta water, then drain.
Let the greens shine
Thinly slice the garlic. Gently cook it in a little oil for 1 minute without browning. Add washed spinach and stir until just wilted.
Toss it all together
Add the spaghetti to the greens. Toss with a splash of pasta water until glossy. Taste for salt and serve.

name: Sunny tomato skillet
description: Soft tomatoes and eggs, gently simmered into the coziest little skillet.
steps: Make the tomato base
Finely chop the onion and tomatoes. Soften the onion in a little oil over medium heat for 3 minutes. Add tomatoes and a splash of water; simmer for 7 minutes until saucy.
Add the eggs
Make small wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs. Cover the pan and cook gently until both whites and yolks are firm.
Finish at the table
Season with salt and pepper, then divide the eggs and sauce between bowls. Serve immediately.

name: Better-at-home egg rice
description: Fluffy egg, warm rice, and a handful of greens. A satisfying bowl from everyday staples.
steps: Start with the rice
Cook the dry rice according to its packet instructions, then drain well. Spread it briefly on a plate while you prepare the eggs.
Scramble and stir
Heat a little oil in a wide pan. Beat the eggs, add to the pan, and stir until fully set. Add washed spinach and cook until wilted.
Bring on the rice
Add the freshly cooked rice and stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until hot throughout. Season with salt. Serve immediately.

name: Golden garlic rice
description: Fragrant garlic and onion bring a pot of rice beautifully to life.
steps: Soften and sizzle
Dice the onion and mince the garlic. Heat a little oil in a saucepan, soften the onion for 4 minutes, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds.
A little patience
Stir in rinsed rice. Add water in the ratio recommended on its packet and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer for the packet cooking time.
Fluff and enjoy
Remove from heat and rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and serve.

name: Everyday green scramble
description: Soft scrambled eggs folded around bright green spinach. Simple is a good thing.
steps: Ready your greens
Wash the spinach and drain. Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Wilt and fold
Heat a little oil over medium-low heat. Add the spinach and stir until wilted, then pour in the eggs.
Slow and gentle
Use a spatula to gently fold the eggs until fully set. Divide between plates and serve straight away.

name: One-pan tomato mince & rice
description: A hearty pot of rice and tomato-rich mince. All the flavor, one happy pan.
steps: Brown the mince

Heat a little oil in a wide pan with a lid. Add ground meat and cook thoroughly, breaking it apart; ground beef or pork should reach 71°C, and ground poultry 74°C. Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Let it simmer
Stir in rinsed rice and the amount of water its packet recommends. Add salt, cover, and simmer for the packet cooking time, adding water if needed.
Rest and serve
Check that the rice is tender. Turn off the heat and leave covered for 5 minutes, then fluff and season with pepper.
